Questions

Are these Cache lineups free?

Yes. The 19 lineups on this page are free to watch. RushB has 39 Cache lineups in total — the rest, and the combos, are in the app with RushB Pro.

How do I practise Cache smokes?

Start an offline match on Cache with unlimited nades and the grenade camera, then repeat each throw with sv_rethrow_last_grenade. The full setup is in our guide how to practice nades in CS2.

Is Cache in the CS2 map pool?

Yes. Cache came back to the Active Duty pool on July 8, 2026, in place of Overpass. It is one of the seven maps of Premier and the pro scene.
